variants.candidate: With too much Earth, the banks press in until the water barely moves. Every rule you meet turns into a judge of you. Read one slow book before the next demand.
variants.original: Run heavy, the banks close in: current squeezed into a schedule until the water forgets it moves. Widen the channel. Rivers are meant to breathe.
